Analyze streaming interaction transcript logs across conversation sessions.

Computes empirical tool call accuracy, self-correction recovery efficiency,

token economics, composite model rankings, and diagnostic prompt tuning

recommendations. Requires --file or --dir; model labels come from --model or

the vendor-neutral unlabeled bucket when omitted.

  Evaluate a specific conversation transcript
  zqk system metrics llm --file path/to/transcript.jsonl
  Evaluate all transcripts under a directory
  zqk system metrics llm --dir path/to/transcripts
  Label ranking buckets with an explicit model id
  zqk system metrics llm --file path/to/transcript.jsonl --model my-model --format json

Usage:
  zqk system metrics llm [flags]

Flags:
      --dir string             Directory containing conversation transcript logs (required unless --file)
      --file string            Path to a specific transcript.jsonl file (required unless --dir)
  -f, --format string          Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --model string           Optional model label for ranking buckets (empty uses unlabeled)
  -o, --output string          Write output to file
  -q, --quiet[=true|false]     Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration       Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose[=true|false]   Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded[=true|false]   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
